items.text: Let it be — Ravick is mid-stride and already answered: he prayed, got a reply at 872, and has since kitted himself out (potion, spoon, leather armor equipped) and walked up to the goblin. His one misfire, `Speak to goblin` landing as speech, he corrected himself in nine seconds with `Talk to goblin`, which the room answered. He needs nothing from the air right now, and he's carrying a spoon toward a valley that already has a use for one.
